name: search_companies
description: Filter Russian legal entities by annual income (FNS open data), region, industry code (OKVED), headcount and bankruptcy status.

arguments.name: status
arguments.desc: Company status filter: 'active' (default) or 'bankrupt' (in bankruptcy proceedings).

arguments.name: revenue_min
arguments.desc: Minimum annual income in rubles (FNS open data; total income, not revenue line 2110).

arguments.name: revenue_max
arguments.desc: Maximum annual income in rubles (FNS open data).

arguments.name: revenue_year
arguments.desc: Year of the FNS annual snapshot used for the income filter.

arguments.name: region_code
arguments.desc: Comma-separated Russian region codes, e.g. '77,78' (active companies).

arguments.name: okved
arguments.desc: Comma-separated OKVED industry code prefixes, e.g. '47.1,47.2'.

arguments.name: order_by
arguments.desc: Sort order: revenue_desc, revenue_asc, random or recent_bankruptcy.

name: get_company
description: Full company card by INN in one call: identity (name, OGRN, address), financials, tax regime, bankruptcy, inspections and other registry data.

name: get_company_financials
description: Multi-year financial statements by INN from official filings: revenue, profit, assets and ratios; amounts in thousands of rubles.

name: get_company_timeline
description: Dated event feed for a company by INN: bankruptcy proceedings (EFRSB), state inspections (ERKNM), trademarks, official gazette notices and other registry events.

name: check_account
description: API account status for the current key: balance, plan, daily quota and usage (requires an API key).
